text:
harpreet: Observing a parity issue: Node SDK sometimes returns fncall/json-mode outputs as a single-element array when the jsonSchema declares type: 'object'. Breaks samplekit onboarding validation.

rebecca: Can you paste the minimal client invocation?

harpreet: ```js
client.call({
  model: 'redwood-small',
  mode: 'json',
  function: 'summarize',
  jsonSchema: { type: 'object', properties: { summary: { type: 'string' } } },
  input: text
})
```
Expected `{ summary: '...' }`, occasionally get `[ { summary: '...' } ]`.

kim: Is this tied to retries or streaming frame joins? We had a similar note in tickets about double-parse after auth-backoff.

harpreet: Strong correlation with retries: when a 5xx triggers the SDK retry layer, the final parsed payload ends up wrapped. Python SDK doesn't reproduce.

oz: Sounds like a node-sdk parity bug around the retry + streaming JSON path. Guessing the parser normalizes partial frames into arrays and an extra normalization step is missing.

rebecca: Quick mitigation: samplekit's validator can coerce single-element arrays -> object when schema.type==='object' and jsonMode=true. Add a lint rule warning until SDK fix ships.

kim: Agreed. I'll open a small helper in samplekit: `normalizeJsonModeOutput(parsed, schema)` that does safe coercions and logs metric `jsonmode.safe_coerce_count`.

ci-bot: :warning: samplekit/onboard-e2e flaky - 5 failures in last 24h

harpreet: I'll file an actionable issue in node-sdk with repro steps and a short harness that simulates a mid-stream 502. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/issues/1120 (draft).

oz: Plan: rebecca to send PR in node-sdk that ensures parse path always returns the unwrapped type when schema indicates object; add unit tests that feed `[ { ... } ]` and assert final return is object (and also assert we do NOT coerce multi-element arrays). kim to add samplekit lint + temp patch. harpreet to create staging e2e that forces retry.

rebecca: PR opened WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/830 - adds defensive normalization only when jsonMode & fncall & schema.type==='object' and includes unit+integration tests. ETA EOD tomorrow.

kim: I'll add the lint rule and a tiny migration note in samplekit README: "If you rely on jsonMode fncall outputs, upgrade to node-sdk >=1.8.1 which normalizes single-element array wrapping in retry scenarios."

harpreet: Also recommending we add a small SDK helper: `validateAndCoerce(schema, value)` in the SDK helpers package so customers can reuse it. Will sketch RFC in internal docs.

oz: Long-term: prefer stricter schema validation errors (fail fast) rather than silent coercion, but small safe coercions for single-element containers are acceptable with a visible metric. We'll discuss RFC during eng-sync.

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: CI queued for node-sdk/pr-830 - unit suite + samplekit-e2e

rebecca: Note for support: if customers see `TypeError: summary is undefined` in jsonMode fncall flows, ask them to upgrade to v1.8.1+ or apply the samplekit normalize workaround. I'll draft a short blurb after PR merges.

harpreet: Thanks. If anyone wants the staging creds to reproduce, ping me.

(ends)
